steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Fuze, sitrep?

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Clear.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Defenders are pretty lazy. Zero guard against us storming them, and we didn't give them any time to notify their superiors.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Good work.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Time to begin the siege.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Everyone, we have to act quickly. Don't get sloppy, and don't give the defenders any time to react.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Let's go.

steps.name: Cowardly Soldier
steps.text: Did you hear something out there just now? An explosion?

steps.name: Tired Soldier
steps.text: Think so.

steps.name: Cowardly Soldier
steps.text: No way those lunatics actually came crashing in...

steps.name: Tired Soldier
steps.text: For what? To rescue Reynell?

steps.name: Tired Soldier
steps.text: No more hallucinating. Catch. This one's some sorta Yanese porcelain. Might smash with a single bump. Careful.

steps.name: Cowardly Soldier
steps.text: You almost smashed it along with the entire display case just now. You turn around and tell me...

steps.name: Cowardly Soldier
steps.text: By the way, didn't our leader break that vase thing, and say he was going upstairs to report to El Capitán? How come he's still not back?

steps.name: Tired Soldier
steps.text: Probably still climbing the stairs, just like the first time we came.

steps.name: Tired Soldier
steps.text: Or he's talking with El Capitán about giving these things a home. Maybe they've even figured out how much each of them are pocketing—

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Grenade out!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: No hostages in the room! Take out the defenders!

steps.name: Tired Soldier
steps.text: The hell? You guys?

steps.name: Tired Soldier
steps.text: Don't wimp out! Their rapid-fire doesn't pack enough punch!

steps.name: Cowardly Soldier
steps.text: I... I'm not scared, I just want to find somewhere safe to call for reinforcements—

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Don't even think about it.

steps.name: Tired Soldier
steps.text: Grr. Decent shot.

steps.name: Tired Soldier
steps.text: Shame your charges just now were too weak. Took less from that than a slug bite—

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: And how about now?

steps.name: Cowardly Soldier
steps.text: Wait, you're the attackers? You must be crazy to seriously—

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Of course we're serious.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Ela, what's that thing you say... Clear?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Nice work, but give us a heads up next time.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Doc, Iana, keep moving per Tequila's directions to the bulk of the hostages. Hostage safety is priority one.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: No rash action in a bad situation. I'll lead the others to sweep the first floor of defenders, then we'll rendezvous with you.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Copy.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Diaz, Tecno, let's go.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Diaz?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Look at all this art. Palladulis Throwing a Javelin—a Minoan statue. This one's a pure gold, gilded enamel revolving vase from Yan...

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: And a manuscript from the great Ursine author Sergei Katayev... let me see which one of his it is...

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: ...'A Receiver Electrifying, or, In the Mire of the Heart.'

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Damn it all. This is the one. Reynell has it in his collection.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: He and Mateo are two kinds of scoundrels. One's blowing it up, one's selling it all... nothing but...

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Whatever. We'll leave it to the next guys to sort out. Let's move.

a.text: In a deathly silent room, there is but a rapidly, incessantly pounding heart, and naught else. Save for—

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: S—Stay back! I'm not letting you in! You come in and we'll take you with us—

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: (Scratching noises about the door can be heard.)

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: The—The noise is gone. She's gone...

steps.name: Slacking Soldier
steps.text: Tut-tut-tut. What a scary scene.

steps.name: Worn-Out Soldier
steps.text: What was this flick called...? Oh, Panic at the Museum: The Sankta Slaughter. This is the one by that Sarkaz director who lives in Columbia.

steps.name: Slacking Soldier
steps.text: Figures they made the villain a Sankta in this one then.

steps.name: Worn-Out Soldier
steps.text: Looks like Reynell's security isn't too busy most of the time. Guess all he can do is sit here watching tapes and fantasizing about murders taking place in his gallery.

steps.name: Slacking Soldier
steps.text: Good for them, though?

steps.name: Slacking Soldier
steps.text: The way El Capitán sees it, everyone worth anything is downstairs moving stuff already. Meanwhile you've got us, who don't really care two ways about him, and we get to sit here on cushy guard duty—

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: There's trouble downstairs! I want a report from anyone who knows what, ASAP!

steps.name: Slacking Soldier
steps.text: Trouble?

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: There's gunfire and explosions down there! People on the sixth floor heard it! What's going on with you?! Are you blind or deaf?!

steps.name: Worn-Out Soldier
steps.text: (Whisper) I told you to turn the volume down a little, but no you wouldn't.

steps.name: Slacking Soldier
steps.text: (Whisper) Shut up, you!

steps.name: Slacking Soldier
steps.text: I'll contact downstairs straight away!

steps.name: Slacking Soldier
steps.text: —Ugh, nope. Not getting through.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Would I be asking you if I could?!

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: I want you to figure out what happened downstairs immediately! If there are troublemakers, flatten them! If they're fighting their way in, I want them out! Getting the art into the trucks is our highest priority!

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: Don't go, Scardullo, don't! Nobody who goes downstairs ever comes back!

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: That Sankta woman's gone crazy! I saw her kill everyone in a public bathroom, and now she's after our lives!
As waves of screams and shrieks emanate from the TV, the seven or eight soldiers in the one cramped surveillance room all look at each other in dismay.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Good news. Defenders in the surveillance room haven't noticed our drones.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Most hostages inside are in shock, and it appears the defenders have robbed them too, but at least there are no casualties, and emotions seem manageable.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Defenders have noticed something's not right downstairs. I assume they reported to their superiors just now, but clearly none are willing to leave what must seem like their safe little panopticon.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Good news indeed. You keep monitoring them, I'll contact Ela. We'll discuss countermeasures.

steps.name: Slacking Soldier
steps.text: Hey? Gabi, what's going on? What the hell was all the ruckus downstairs?

steps.name: Ostracized Soldier
steps.text: I... I... don't know...

steps.name: Slacking Soldier
steps.text: Don't know my ass! You've spent long enough, quit dawdling!

steps.name: Ostracized Soldier
steps.text: I'm—I'm just... minding my surroundings, I just got to the stairwell entrance!

steps.name: Slacking Soldier
steps.text: Your voice is trembling, huevón! What, did the spooky movie get to you? Hahaha!

steps.name: Ostracized Soldier
steps.text: Shut up! Be... Besides, I don't see you down here! It's always like this, you guys shove everything onto me—

steps.name: Slacking Soldier
steps.text: Huh? Gabi?

steps.name: Slacking Soldier
steps.text: Gabi??

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: No! We can't let anyone else go downstairs!

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: Weren't you watching in the surveillance room?! That Sankta madwoman didn't even have to touch her!

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: She just unloaded into the receiver when Scardullo picked up, and turned her into a pile of... of...

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: (The sobbing begins.)

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: What's the situation? Have you figured it out?

steps.name: Slacking Soldier
steps.text: Sir. We sent a man on recon... and he just suddenly stopped responding...

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: You useless sacks!!

steps.name: Slacking Soldier
steps.text: S—Sir, how about you send someone else to the first floor? We... We really can't spare a single man...

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: No response means you keep sending people down, or I stop on the second floor to shoot you all dead before heading down there myself!

steps.name: Spooked Soldier
steps.text: Nobody move! Out!

steps.name: Spooked Soldier
steps.text: Phew... empty...

steps.name: Spooked Soldier
steps.text: Every scout we've sent has gone missing, one by one—maybe the first floor's h... haunted...?
What an imagination you have. Get a little sleep for now.

steps.name: Spooked Soldier
steps.text: Who th—

steps.name: Slacking Soldier
steps.text: Hey? Ramon? Ramon—you—you gotta say something...

steps.name: Slacking Soldier
steps.text: Dropped again... That's... the fourth one...

steps.name: Slacking Soldier
steps.text: Four times, four men... every time, as soon as they get downstairs, they just...
No one picks up on that sentence.
The terminals have all been tossed into one corner of the room. On occasion, the indistinct bellows of El Capitán emanate from the pile, but nobody is giving them a response anymore.

steps.name: Worn-Out Soldier
steps.text: Maybe it's because they went one at a time, so we were just feeding them one by one to—

steps.name: Slacking Soldier
steps.text: So how many do you want to doom each time?!

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: That Sankta madwoman, her mind's not right, she's a homicidal maniac, she, she... she's outside the door! She's smiling at us through the access surveillance cam!

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: Mayo, just hang the intercom up. She can't get in—

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: She's pointing her gun at me! She... She's pulling the trigger!

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: All she can do is wreck the cam! Just calm down!

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: (A gunshot rings out.)

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: W—What the... Mayo... Dead? Is that a bullet hole?!

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: EYAAAAAAAAAAGGGH!

steps.name: Slacking Soldier
steps.text: How... about... we... watch a different tape.
The two stare at each other with slackened gazes for a moment, before the worn-out soldier gets up, travels to another corner of the room, and grabs a random tape to shove into the recorder.

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: ...the 'Art Investor' here from Kazimierz, let's welcome our guest today, Mr. Reynell Kowalski, the new star of Dossoles's art scene!

steps.name: Slacking Soldier
steps.text: What did you put on this for? Are you sick?!

steps.name: Worn-Out Soldier
steps.text: I didn't know they taped the TV on this one!

steps.name: Slacking Soldier
steps.text: Switch it out, switch it out!

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: Hello, hello~ Pleased to meet you, new faces! And it's been a whole day, old faces! It's me, your host for this program, Eure—

steps.name: Slacking Soldier
steps.text: I don't do this, but I'm begging you, switch it again. Listening to this presenter makes my brain hurt.

steps.name: Worn-Out Soldier
steps.text: ...These three tapes are all we've got.

steps.name: Slacking Soldier
steps.text: The security guy just watches these three tapes on repeat?! What do you find if you open up his brain, soup?!

spans.text: The security guy just watches these three tapes on repeat?! What do you find if you open up

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: Today's episode is a special for all you tourists here in Dossoles for the first time...
The worn-out soldier firmly punches the eject button.

steps.name: Worn-Out Soldier
steps.text: Let's just finish watching the movie.

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: You heathenly... devils... Your day of reckoning... is come...

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: I—I—I'm warning you, my grandpa's a big deal in Kazdel! You wouldn't wanna see his witchcraft, even in death!

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: Heheh, HAHAHAhahaha...

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: Don't you laugh so crooked—

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: Hahaha... witchcraft... hahahaha...

a.text: When the firmament is filled by sunlight... when all dark across the land is disappeared without a trace...
She that is the twin moons will fall upon your cagebeast cell... the dark will gush forth into your eyes... and there you will meet...

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Inhabiting Gemini.
Shuffling emits from the center of the room.
A single soldier, biting his lip, shivering head to toe, hands clenched tight, turns his gaze away from the screen... and with a shudder, over his shoulder.
He sees, inside the room, out of nowhere... a bizarre woman.
He sees that woman's complexion and her hair, both just as pale.

He sees that woman point at him with a tremendous firearm the likes of which he's never seen before. No surveillance cam needed now. Those etched bullets can pierce straight through his heart in an instant.
He sees that woman standing there, and yet it is as though she's somewhere else entirely, as though she doesn't even draw breath.
He sees that woman whose head is crowned...
By a halo.

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: Don't look back, don't look back... because I am right... behind you...!!
The soldier that has looked back lets out a breathless wail, leading the others to nervously follow where his gaze has gone—

steps.name: Slacking Soldier
steps.text: TH—THERE'S NO SUCH THINGS AS GHOSTS!!
The soldier's senses tell him his shot landed, but the bolt meets no obstruction as it continues its trajectory, passing straight through the woman's body.
Just like that, she vanishes, and only the afterimage of the halo above her head still—

steps.name: Petrified Soldiers
steps.text: EYAAAAAAAAAAARRRRRGGGH!

steps.name: Slacking Soldier
steps.text: Sir, report, it's a Sankta!!

steps.name: Slacking Soldier
steps.text: The enemy's a Sankta with spatial movement Arts, she's a homicidal maniac, her mind's not right, she can shoot people dead through surveillance cam—

steps.name: Slacking Soldier
steps.text: Urgh!

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Clear.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Clear.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I didn't think just turning the lights out when the Gemini got hit would be enough to spread that much panic...
Meanwhile, on the TV in the corner of the room, the Sankta continues the silver-screen massacre.

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: Kill! Kill! Kill! I'll cut off your horns and hang them as chimes upon the Lateran itself!

steps.name: Newbie Investor
steps.text: Thank you all so much!

steps.name: Newbie Investor
steps.text: If you're after anything in terms of art investments, please be sure to let me—

spans.text: in terms of art investments, please be sure to let me—

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Stop wasting breath, beat those feet!

steps.name: Newbie Investor
steps.text: Right, right...

steps.name: Community Musician
steps.text: Hm? Who's that you're carrying?

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: He got beat up for resisting, and he's still concussed. Faster if I give him a ride.

steps.name: Community Musician
steps.text: Wow. Nice to see some tough stuff among these guys.

steps.name: Community Musician
steps.text: By the way, we're in Exhibition Hall 2 of the Galería right now. Did you get to see that manuscript you wanted?

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: Ugh. Completely forgot about that, evacuating all these people.

steps.name: Destitute Noble
steps.text: Manuscript?

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: A Minoan bard's. Pamphlet says it's the 'highlight of the collection' for Hall 2. Know where it is?

steps.name: Destitute Noble
steps.text: I caught sight of it just now. It's on the other end of the hall; I can take you over if you'd like—

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: Lead the way, then!

steps.name: Destitute Noble
steps.text: Sir, you can put me down now!

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: You're concussed, aren't you?! Just point the way, it'll be faster!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Evac of Hall hostages almost complete.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Things went smoothly thanks to your Gemini Replicator.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: (Shakes head) I didn't know we'd get a break that lucky—it was just meant to be bait, that's all. I was expecting they'd unload all their firepower on the replicate like the community people did.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: All I can say is it took up a good position, and those defenders chose a good movie to pass the time.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Defenders outside the gallery are all swept now. What do we do next? Head to the third floor and rescue Ernesto?

steps.name: Community Artist
steps.text: Wait up!

steps.name: Community Artist
steps.text: You're that, um—that, er... whatever, you can't go any further that way!

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: What happened?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Oh, Mr. Miłosz. Not with Reynell after all, then.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Situation's urgent. Tell us anything surplus after the fact. You need to leave the Galería ASAP.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: You're not going to interrogate me for any useful information?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: We're out of time for that.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: I want to make a deal. I'll give you some information, and I'm hoping that after you have this information...

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: We can rescue Reynell?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Mr. Miłosz, if Reynell hadn't set up the bombs, this terrorist attack may never have come to fruition in the first place.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Reynell couldn't wire the entire Galería with bombs on his own. He suggested the idea, that's all. I imagine you know who carried the deed out.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: I know the timing on the bombs, and how to most efficiently disarm them.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: And that's how you plan to coerce us?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: How could I? You aren't the type to suffer coercion.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: I'm just hoping my willingness to cooperate can pull together a lifeline for him.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Alright. Tell us what you know, then.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: They're time bombs, set to go off this morning at 10 AM. If you want to stop them, you need to take care of four nodes along the detonator line.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: One of the four is in the basement, one's in a darkroom on the third floor, one's on the balcony on the sixth floor, and one is in the ventilation shaft in Reynell's own office.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: ...Sounds almost true.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: The one in the basement is most complicated. I suggest one of you go there with me—

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: I will.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Good. Tecno, take the others. Keep searching for any more places where hostages might be hiding.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Diaz, Catapult, you handle one each of the third and sixth floor nodes. Doc, Iana and I will keep heading for the top. We'll buy more time to disarm the penthouse node.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: The third-floor darkroom's relatively hard to find. It's right above this hall, effectively, but getting there's a nightmare. I need pen and paper to draw a quick map of the route—

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: No need, I'll take it.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Ernesto!

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Leave the darkroom to me and Arleta.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: The sixth floor node is in the stairwell. There's a wall that'll look suspicious, and be very easy to break down.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Leave that to me.

steps.name: Community Artist
steps.text: Phew, I'm finally here, and it's just you two left. So, how do you feel seeing the manuscript—

steps.name: Community Artist
steps.text: Uh, wait, why are you carrying him now?

steps.name: Destitute Noble
steps.text: Urk... As soon as he saw the manuscript, he cried so hard he couldn't even breathe, and eventually passed out from his tears. It was all I could do to bear him on my back instead.

steps.name: Community Artist
steps.text: He passed out?

steps.name: Community Artist
steps.text: Doc, Doc! We need you! Someone's fainted here!

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: He's fine, he just cried himself out. His emotions likely overwhelmed him upon seeing the manuscript of his dreams.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Let him rest for a while in fresh air and he'll be fine.

steps.name: Community Artist
steps.text: I—If you say so...

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: ...Miss Ela, that's every card up my sleeve. It's all yours now.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Noted.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: What happens if we fail? What if we aren't able to rescue him?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: In that case... I'll stay behind and keep him company.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: I hope you can save the others before then, Miss Ela. I don't want any more people than necessary in here.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Right, I've pulled the metal casing off. Inside, there's a total of—

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: —Miłosz, you crackpot! There's twelve whole bomb wires here!

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: What? The one in the basement has over forty connections?!

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Whatever, I'll settle this later.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Right now, I just need to dewire one by one, right?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Yeah. Yeah. Got it. Unscrew as fast as possible, half-connected states can send the explosives runaway easy. Understood.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Ela, how's things on your side?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Small band of resistance on the fourth floor still? Wow.
Diaz stops talking, wipes the sweat off his forehead, and focuses on dealing with the chaotic nest of wires at hand.
He has to decouple fast, and unscrew the connectors right after, using an insulator to cover up the naked wires and avoid any short-circuits.
In a trance, his days with the Singas army float through his mind, where his job was always to secure the connectors in—
Diaz furrows his brows and smacks his lips, hands never stopping. What happened then has nothing to do with now. Now, he's no more than a firefighter in the middle of bomb disposal.
The wires are more or less decoupled by now. Just two left, and all risk of explosion in this area is gone.
He's gotten a handle of how to most quickly twist these connectors off. Push down for the first half, spin slowly, then start turning with all his might for the second half until it's off.
He counts down the rotations on the second connector. Now just seven, six, five...

steps.name: Irate Soldier
steps.text: Seize that old man!
Two of El Capitán's men charge for the old firefighter with sabers in hand, while three crossbows are poised on the floor above.
The old firefighter's hands freeze upon the connector, and for a spell, he's somehow not sure if he's meant to twist one way or the other.
